fullDesc: In 1324 Mansa Musa, emperor of Mali, travelled to Mecca with a huge caravan and so much gold that prices fell in Cairo. He is often described as one of the richest people in history.
realFacts: He gave away so much gold that its value dropped
Timbuktu became a great centre of learning
He brought scholars and architects back to Mali
Medieval maps showed him holding a gold nugget
